verdict.rationale: Portkey explicitly states its AI Gateway is open-sourced and can be run locally with a single command (npx @portkey-ai/gateway), confirming self-hosting of the core routing/gateway component. However, the broader platform features (observability logs, admin/budget controls, model catalog UI) are documented as hosted product features with no evidence they can be self-hosted, so full self-hosting of 'the core product' is not established.
